SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(IF(app_type = 1, 1, 0)) AS cert_apply_count, SUM(IF(app_type = 2, 1, 0)) AS cert_renew_count, SUM(IF(app_type = 3, 1, 0)) AS cert_change_count, SUM(IF(app_type = 4, 1, 0)) AS info_change_count, SUM(IF(app_type = 5, 1, 0)) AS offline_count, SUM(IF(app_type = 6, 1 , 0)) as cancel_count FROM biz_application a left join biz_institution_ext b on a.institution_id = b.dept_id where a.deleted = 0
and app_status = 1
and app_status = 5
and b.city = #{req.region}

select count(*) as total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.license_device_name = 'X线正电子发射断层扫描仪' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as petCtScanner, SUM(CASE WHEN a.license_device_name = '伽玛射线立体定向放射治疗系统' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as gammaRayStereotacticRtSystem, SUM(CASE WHEN a.license_device_name = '直线加速器' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as linearAccelerator, SUM(CASE WHEN a.license_device_name = '内窥镜手术器械控制系统' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as endoscopicSurgicalSystem, SUM(CASE WHEN a.license_device_name = '1.5T及以上磁共振成像系统' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as mriSystem1_5tPlus, SUM(CASE WHEN a.license_device_name = '64排及以上X线计算机断层扫描仪' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ctScanner64SlicePlus FROM biz_license_original a left join biz_license_duplicate d on a.id = d.original_id left join biz_application b on a.application_id = b.id left join biz_institution_ext c on b.institution_id = c.dept_id where a.deleted = 0 and d.acceptance_status = 1
and c.city = #{req.region}

select count(*) as total_count, SUM(IF(specialty = '放射影像', 1, 0)) AS radiology_imaging, SUM(IF(specialty = '放射治疗', 1, 0)) AS radiation_therapy, SUM(IF(specialty = '核医学', 1, 0)) AS nuclear_medicine, SUM(IF(specialty = '卫生管理', 1, 0)) AS health_management, SUM(IF(specialty = '医学设备与安全防护', 1, 0)) AS medical_equipment_safety, SUM(IF(specialty = '医学智能工程', 1, 0)) AS medical_intelligent_engineering FROM biz_expert_ext where deleted = 0 and specialty IS NOT NULL

select count(a.id) as total, SUM(IF(a.status = '已发布', 1, 0)) AS publishedCount, SUM(IF(a.status = '未发布', 1, 0)) AS draftCount, SUM(IF(d.is_read = 1, 1, 0)) AS totalViews from biz_notifications a LEFT JOIN biz_user_notification_status d on a.id = d.notification_id left join biz_application b on a.app_id = b.id left join biz_institution_ext c on b.institution_id = c.dept_id where a.deleted = 0 and a.visibility = 'system' and a.creator='0'
and c.city = #{req.region}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN main_equipment_type = '01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS petCtScanner, SUM(CASE WHEN main_equipment_type = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gammaRayStereotacticRtSystem, SUM(CASE WHEN main_equipment_type = '03' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linearAccelerator, SUM(CASE WHEN main_equipment_type = '04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS endoscopicSurgicalSystem, SUM(CASE WHEN main_equipment_type = '05' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mriSystem1_5tPlus, SUM(CASE WHEN main_equipment_type = '06' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ctScanner64SlicePlus FROM biz_equipment_manufacturer WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN license_device_name = 'X线正电子发射断层扫描仪' THEN 1 END) AS petCtScanner, COUNT(CASE WHEN license_device_name = '伽玛射线立体定向放射治疗系统' THEN 1 END) AS gammaRayStereotacticRtSystem, COUNT(CASE WHEN license_device_name = '直线加速器' THEN 1 END) AS linearAccelerator, COUNT(CASE WHEN license_device_name = '内窥镜手术器械控制系统' THEN 1 END) AS endoscopicSurgicalSystem, COUNT(CASE WHEN license_device_name = '1.5T及以上磁共振成像系统' THEN 1 END) AS mriSystem1_5tPlus, COUNT(CASE WHEN license_device_name = '64排及以上X线计算机断层扫描仪' THEN 1 END) AS ctScanner64SlicePlus, COUNT(CASE WHEN license_device_name = '首次配置的大型医疗器械' THEN 1 END) AS firstTimeLargeMedicalDevice, COUNT(CASE WHEN license_device_name = '高端放射治疗类设备' THEN 1 END) AS highEndRtEquipment, COUNT(CASE WHEN license_device_name = '重离子质子放射治疗系统' THEN 1 END) AS heavyIonProtonRtSystem FROM biz_class_a_equipment WHERE deleted = 0
AND YEAR(create_time) = #{year}

SELECT COUNT(a.id) AS total, COUNT(CASE WHEN b.license_device_name = 'X线正电子发射断层扫描仪' THEN 1 END) AS petCtScanner, COUNT(CASE WHEN b.license_device_name = '伽玛射线立体定向放射治疗系统' THEN 1 END) AS gammaRayStereotacticRtSystem, COUNT(CASE WHEN b.license_device_name = '直线加速器' THEN 1 END) AS linearAccelerator, COUNT(CASE WHEN b.license_device_name = '内窥镜手术器械控制系统' THEN 1 END) AS endoscopicSurgicalSystem, COUNT(CASE WHEN b.license_device_name = '1.5T及以上磁共振成像系统' THEN 1 END) AS mriSystem1_5tPlus, COUNT(CASE WHEN b.license_device_name = '64排及以上X线计算机断层扫描仪' THEN 1 END) AS ctScanner64SlicePlus FROM biz_institution_ext a LEFT JOIN biz_application b ON a.dept_id = b.institution_id WHERE b.app_status = 5
select b.city as region, count(a.id) as total from biz_application a left join biz_institution_ext b on a.institution_id = b.dept_id where a.deleted = 0 and b.deleted = 0

WITH yearly_counts AS ( SELECT YEAR(create_time) AS `year`, COUNT(*) AS yearly_count FROM biz_license_original WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY YEAR(create_time) ), yearly_growth AS ( SELECT `year`, yearly_count, LAG(yearly_count, 1) OVER (ORDER BY `year`) AS prev_year_count FROM yearly_counts ) SELECT `year`, yearly_count AS inc_count, prev_year_count AS prev_count, ROUND( CASE WHEN prev_year_count IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN prev_year_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (yearly_count - prev_year_count) * 100.0 / prev_year_count END, 2 ) AS yoy_rate FROM yearly_growth ORDER BY `year`
SELECT ladder_config_model AS model, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS percentage FROM biz_license_original WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY ladder_config_model

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(CASE WHEN app_type = 5 THEN 1 END) AS offline_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN app_type != 5 THEN 1 END) AS online_count FROM biz_application WHERE app_status = 5
and YEAR(create_time) = #{year}
mapper.sql: CASE a.xksbmc WHEN 'DXSB0374_5' THEN 'X线正电子发射断层扫描仪' WHEN 'DXSB0374_6' THEN '内窥镜手术器械控制系统' WHEN 'DXSB0374_7' THEN '64排及以上X线计算机断层扫描仪' WHEN 'DXSB0374_8' THEN '1.5T及以上磁共振成像系统' WHEN 'DXSB0374_9' THEN '直线加速器' WHEN 'DXSB0374_10' THEN '伽玛射线立体定向放射治疗系统' END
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.xksbmc = 'DXSB0374_8' THEN a.id END) AS mriSystem1_5tPlus, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.xksbmc = 'DXSB0374_6' THEN a.id END) AS endoscopicSurgicalSystem, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.xksbmc = 'DXSB0374_5' THEN a.id END) AS petCtScanner, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.xksbmc = 'DXSB0374_7' THEN a.id END) AS ctScanner64SlicePlus, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.xksbmc = 'DXSB0374_10' THEN a.id END) AS gammaRayStereotacticRtSystem, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.xksbmc = 'DXSB0374_9' THEN a.id END) AS linearAccelerator, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS total FROM "history_license" a left join history_area e on a.sbpzdzCode = e.id
a.xksbmc IN ('DXSB0374_5', 'DXSB0374_6', 'DXSB0374_7', 'DXSB0374_8', 'DXSB0374_9', 'DXSB0374_10')
and e.FULLNAME like concat('%', #{req.region},'%')

SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.CREATED_DATE, '/', 1) AS `year`, AS deviceName, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS count FROM history_license a LEFT JOIN history_area e ON a.sbpzdzCode = e.id
a.xksbmc IN ('DXSB0374_5', 'DXSB0374_6', 'DXSB0374_7', 'DXSB0374_8', 'DXSB0374_9', 'DXSB0374_10') AND a.CREATED_DATE IS NOT NULL
AND IN
#{item}
AND e.FULLNAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.region}, '%')
GROUP BY SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.CREATED_DATE, '/', 1), ORDER BY `year`

SELECT city.name AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS count FROM history_license a LEFT JOIN history_area e ON a.sbpzdzCode = e.id LEFT JOIN history_area city ON city.id = CASE WHEN e.levelx = 3 THEN e.pid ELSE e.id END
city.name IS NOT NULL
AND e.fullname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.region}, '%')
GROUP BY city.name ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN e.levelx = 3 THEN e.name ELSE '市本级' END AS county, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS count FROM history_license a LEFT JOIN history_area e ON a.sbpzdzCode = e.id LEFT JOIN history_area city ON city.id = CASE WHEN e.levelx = 3 THEN e.pid ELSE e.id END
city.name IS NOT NULL
AND city.name = #{region}
AND e.fullname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.region}, '%')
GROUP BY CASE WHEN e.levelx = 3 THEN e.name ELSE '市本级' END ORDER BY count DESC
